chapter: Benny Goodman and first US jobs
title: Meeting Bird and the Stardust record that reached Benny Goodman
summary: He met Charlie Parker in Paris; his guitar-and-strings record reached Billy Shaw and Goodman.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: No, I, yeah. But for me, you know, because that festival had Miles Davis with his group. It had Charlie Parker. And these were all the big stars of bebop. So…
I was just wondering, for you to...

[unintelligible]. But that’s… this guy [Parnacier?], he stayed there. He was… But he still made a little noise, if I remember. But I met Bird then, and he had heard that little record. I had made the record that I sent, then wound up on the phonograph of Billy Shaw. You

know, I told you about Billy Shaw. And that were my harmonies, my own Stardust with [in a garage?], four strings, in Belgian, you know? Or you had… and some friends and, okay. And I recorded a few things with the guitar and that got to the phonograph, eventually, of Benny Goodman. That’s how I got the job with Benny.
